name: AshtangaYoga@42 (Jakarta)
reason: The website on the Sharath Yoga Centre directory, ashtangayoga42.com, did not answer over https (no connection for robots.txt), so it is treated as unreachable and no other route was tried. One web search shows the shala is part of the Yoga@42 group, a multi-style studio network (Bikram, aerial, hot Ashtanga, HIIT) that reads as fitness-led rather than a school.
